description: Returns a unique symmetric data key for use outside of KMS. This operation returns a plaintext copy of the data key and a copy that is encrypted under a symmetric encryption KMS key that you specify.

researchLinks.description: Detecting multi-stage attacks on AWS: A guide to cross-service signal correlation

securityImplications: Attackers might use GenerateDataKey on a KMS key they do not own to obtain data keys for encrypting a victim's data, for example as part of a ransomware operation.
